expectations.text: Rejects headers-only communication as a named failure mode - shipping the header does not mean anyone was reached.
expectations.evidence: "A header-only plan satisfies the RFC and reaches almost nobody. This is a named failure mode."

expectations.text: States the reason: most integrators' tooling does not surface these headers, so a header-only plan satisfies the RFC while reaching no one.
expectations.evidence: "Most API tooling and HTTP clients ignore these headers."

expectations.text: Distinguishes the two headers' roles: a Deprecation signal that deprecation is coming or here, and a Sunset header carrying the exact timestamp the version stops responding.
expectations.evidence: "Ship Deprecation first. Add Sunset once the date is firm." and "`Sunset: <date>`".

expectations.text: Identifies the Deprecation header with RFC 9745 and notes it can ship before any sunset date exists and changes no behavior.
expectations.evidence: It cites RFC 9745 and says to ship Deprecation first, but never says the header changes no behavior.

expectations.text: Identifies the Sunset header with RFC 8594 and notes that RFC is Informational rather than Standards Track, citing it accordingly.
expectations.evidence: "RFC 8594 (`Sunset`) is Informational, not Standards Track."

expectations.text: Scopes the Sunset header to the deprecated version's responses only.
expectations.evidence: "`Sunset: <date>` (RFC 8594) on all v2 responses", where v2 is the deprecated version.

expectations.text: Adds a successor-version link relation so tooling can find the replacement without scraping prose.
expectations.evidence: "`Link: <v3-url>; rel=\"successor-version\"` (RFC 8288)"

expectations.text: Marks the deprecated operations with deprecated: true in the OpenAPI document so docs and codegen surface it.
expectations.evidence: "`deprecated: true` in the v2 OpenAPI document"

expectations.text: Pairs the headers with at least one channel that reaches humans: changelog, developer-dashboard banner, email, or in-response warnings.
expectations.evidence: Changelog, docs banner, dashboard banner and email.

expectations.text: Recommends targeted outreach at the accounts still calling the deprecated version (or warnings embedded in API responses, which reach exactly the affected callers) rather than only a mass announcement.
expectations.evidence: "Repeat the email to keys still calling v2" and "In-response warning ... reaches exactly the callers still affected."
